title: Inject active goal into prompt context
objective: Make active Goal visible to the model through existing prompt context plumbing.
context: The model needs the goal condition even before evaluator continuation starts.
The injection must be inactive for achieved, blocked, cleared, or absent goals.

source_evidence.note: snapshot.UserContext.PrependTo is already part of request assembly.

include: Extend prompt context types with optional Goal context.
Render concise objective, budget, and last evaluator reason when present.

implementation_steps: Add goal field to prompt user context or adjacent context struct.
Format the context in one helper.
Run prompt and loop goal context tests.
deliverables: Active goal appears in model-visible context.
acceptance_criteria: No-goal tests or snapshots remain unchanged.
The context does not imply permission changes.
risks: Prompt text could become too verbose and consume context.
dispatch_prompt: Implement active Goal prompt context injection using existing UserContext plumbing. Keep no-goal behavior unchanged and context text concise.
notes_for_assignee: If loop/query_snapshot.go does not exist, update the actual snapshot file that owns newQueryConfigSnapshot.
